meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: When to delegate to `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit) or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of working inline or using `Explore`. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需分派子代理处理代码定位、修改与审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想通过子代理分工节省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate to sub-agents for code search, edits, and reviews to save context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI and want to manage context by delegating tasks to sub-agents.

howto.what: Claude 会把三类活派给子代理：定位代码、改 1~2 个文件、审查 diff，分别由 cavecrew-investigator、builder、reviewer 负责。它们返回的结果是压缩过的，主上下文更省。
howto.when: 当你让它找某段代码在哪、改 1~2 个文件、或审查一次改动时，会派给对应子代理；答案你已知的一行问题仍由主线程直接回答。

say.text: 帮我找出 handleLogin 在哪定义、谁调用了它
把 src/auth.ts 第 42 行的超时从 30 改成 60
say.note: 派给 builder，改完会回读校验

say.text: 审查当前分支的 diff 有没有 bug
say.note: 派给 reviewer，按文件和行号列问题

howto.what_en: Claude routes three kinds of work to subagents: locating code, editing 1-2 files, and reviewing a diff, handled by cavecrew-investigator, builder, and reviewer. Their replies are compressed, so your main context lasts longer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask where code lives, request a 1-2 file edit, or want a diff reviewed; these go to the matching subagent. One-line answers you already know stay in the main thread.

say_en.text: Find where handleLogin is defined and who calls it
say_en.note: Goes to investigator; returns a path:line list

say_en.text: In src/auth.ts, change the timeout on line 42 from 30 to 60
say_en.note: Goes to builder; it re-reads to verify

say_en.text: Review the current branch diff for bugs
say_en.note: Goes to reviewer; findings sorted by file and line
